bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
if ! test -d "$r"; then exit 51; fi
if ! test -d "$r/.git" && ! test -f "$r/.git"; then exit 52; fi
origin="$(git -C "$r" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^.*github.com[:/]##;s#\.git$##')"
if test "$origin" != seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot; then exit 53; fi
if test -n "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)"; then exit 54; fi
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null)" != active; then exit 55; fi
if test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null)" != enabled; then exit 56; fi
if ! test -f "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"; then exit 57; fi
if ! test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"; then exit 58; fi
if ! python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null; then exit 59; fi
echo USERBOT_DISCOVERY_PREFLIGHT=PASS
